entries: your own drink is off-limits. Every sip comes from someone else's, with their blessing
you drink with your pinky out, every single time, no exceptions
you must announce what you're drinking before every sip like you're trying to talk a bartender into one more round
you hold eye contact with someone the entire time you're mid-sip
every sip is a shot, mentally. Treat it like the worst decision you're about to make
you can't just drink. You have to sell it like the best decision you've made all night
every sip gets a sound effect. Gasp, sigh, whatever sells it
you drink like someone's about to cut you off and you're getting this one in first
you can't set your drink down between sips. It stays in your hand the whole time
